experiment: 1: break on a wrong country feature in the carrier cell, repair by one named component, continue
status: sealed before any showcase job; single seed
sae: Qwen-Scope W32K-L0_50 layer 19 (site of t<crow>.L20.h), SAELens to_saelens() strict copy checked on every census item

census_rule_frozen_before_depth_arms.items: the 64 base items (1a) plus the 44 d1/d2 depth items (never scored here; disclosed deviation: the memo names base 64 only; d1/d2 are added because 9 of the 17 wrong-item countries have <= 1 base item, e.g. Czech 1 base item, 7 wrong items)
census_rule_frozen_before_depth_arms.admission: feature f is a country feature of country c when it is active at L19 (carrier row) on >= 2 census items of c and on >= 0.5 of c's census items, and on <= 2/57 (0.035) of the census items of other countries; if two countries qualify the larger share wins; label(f) = c's country token
census_rule_frozen_before_depth_arms.a_truth: median activation of the country's admitted feature with the largest median activation over c's census items where it is active (supplied constant, frozen in census.json before the depth job)
census_rule_frozen_before_depth_arms.frozen_in: exp1/census.json committed before the depth job

panel: the 110 d3-lm/d3-per/d4-work items of 1c: 27 wrong, 83 correct (b1-score.json); consumers M[true language, native argmax] on wrong items and the argmax

predictions.W1: the watch fires on >= 20/27 wrong d3/d4 items and <= 10/83 correct ones (below 15/27 means the country code is not in the dictionary's country features at this row)
predictions.W2: R1 moves the argmax to the true language on >= 11 of the items where the watch fired, and R1's margin move is >= 0.6 of R2's on the median item
predictions.W3: R1 produces a donor-entity copy on 0 items, R2 on >= 3 of the city-donor items
predictions.W4: R3 moves M by less than the floor on >= 0.75 of items
predictions.nulls: random active non-country feature component swapped at matched norm (expect <= 2 repairs); the same R1 edit on correct items (expect <= 3/83 argmax changes); the always-last-row cell instead of R_argmax (watch evaluated there too)
predictions.falsifier: R1 repairs fewer items than the random-feature null plus 2, or W1 fails

operational_definitions.watch: mdb breakpoints.Table.add_watch('t<last>.L20.h', mode='level', compiled=FeatureCondition('best_feature(COUNTRIES) >= 0 and best_feature(COUNTRIES) != truth')) with FeatureContext(basis L19, row=carrier, layer=20, kv=6, sets COUNTRIES = admitted features, labels = their country tokens, truth = item country token); run by breakpoints.run_forward from t<last>.start; the carrier row comes from a native run of the same item (R_argmax needs the answer row's L20 p, which is after the stop)
operational_definitions.R1: set carrier += component(truth) - component(best_wrong): component(truth) = Binding.component image of a_truth(country) * d_f(truth feature); component(best_wrong) the measured component of the most active wrong country feature; items whose country has no admitted feature get R1 = -component(best_wrong) only and are reported separately; on correct items R1 = +component(truth) - component(most active non-truth country feature, if any)
operational_definitions.R2: whole-cell donor: the carrier cell of a correct d3/d4/d2/d1 item of the same country (same family first, then d3/d4, then d2, then d1; first by id), set at the recipient's carrier
operational_definitions.R3: error-component swap: carrier - error(recipient) + error(donor of R2)
operational_definitions.random null: remove a uniformly drawn (seed 20261114) active non-country feature component and add the image of a uniformly drawn inactive non-country feature, the summed change rescaled to ||R1 change||
operational_definitions.repair: argmax == true language token after the arm
operational_definitions.entity copy: the argmax token's text (stripped, lowercased) is a word of the donor's entity name (R2) or of the recipient's own entity name (R1)
operational_definitions.floor: 2 bf16 spacings at the larger |logit| of the pair
operational_definitions.verify: for R1 arms mdb forecast.seal on the margin after the edit is committed (cursor past L20 of the answer row) and forecast.verify at the logits; refusals recorded

arms_on: all 27 wrong items (R1, R2, R3, random) and R1 on all 83 correct; R2/R3/random also on 27 correct items matched by family (first by id)
